about: Files some numbers need that this repository does not ship. Each copy was saved on 2026-11-09. Pass a folder of copies with: python3 -I rederive/run.py data --sources <folder>. A copy is used only if its sha256 equals the one here; live pages change, so a fresh download will usually differ and its rows stay 'needs source file'.

gov-hsp007-execution-42147.json.used_for: HSP-007's payout ledger (families/m3-m8-m7/hsp007.py) and SVRN's onboarding date (compare.py, row 52)

nearstats-api-near-summary.json.used_for: the number of chains NearStats lists as supported for Intents, and the feed's date (compare.py, row 14)

web-update.swe.at_.html.used_for: the date Sweat Wallet ends in its present form (compare.py, row 52)

web-docs.near.org_omnibridge_overview.ht.used_for: the chains NEAR's Omni overview lists with Chain Signatures (compare.py, row 13)
